_doc: Per-run tuning (phase 1). Distances in screen pixels at the world scale, times in seconds. See design/game-brief.md.

xp._cap_doc: One xp gain (a gem, an elite, the boss) gives at most max_levels_per_gain levels; the overflow fills at most overflow_keep of the next bar, the rest is lost (user 2026-11-18: many level-ups at once broke the balance).

rewards._doc: Equipment won: one random item (any slot, fitting the class or shared) when a stage is won; chest_item_chance = chance that opening a chest also gives one.

essence._doc: Tinh hoa (skill-tree material, design/skill-tree.md) a kill drops: elites and bosses only; picked up like other drops and kept for the slot, won or lost.

elite._doc: Every monster also exists as '<id>@elite' (waves spawn it by that name): hp, damage, size and xp multiplied; it has a gold halo and drops a chest (one extra card pick).

affixes._doc: Elite affixes (design 6A, user 2026-11-18): each elite rolls one; its halo takes the colour and its name shows above it. speed_mul, damage_taken_mul (armour), split_count (plain monsters of its kind on death), explode (a warning ring then a blast on death; damage_mul x its contact damage). Refs: Diablo 4 / PoE monster modifiers, Risk of Rain 2 readability.

buffs._doc: Random buff spawns (items.json buffs): first after first_after s, then every spawn_every [min,max] s one random buff on a ring spawn_ring [min,max] px around the player; it stays lifetime s (blinks the last blink s); at most max_on_field at once; picked up when the badge circle (collect_radius px, about half the drawn badge) touches the hero body circle (user 2026-11-20).

_hero_art_doc: Hero look in the run (user 2026-11-23 trial): lpc = the class's lpc_sprite (LPC adult, assets/sprites/custom/lpc-<class>, made by gamekit sprites), minifig = the old layered 48 px sprite. Equipment pictures are drawn only on minifig heroes for now; stats apply either way.

hit_feel._doc: Cảm giác đánh (2026-11-23): a hit spark at the hit point of every physical-element hit (species.json elements; skills' element), at most max_per_frame a frame, none at Hiệu ứng: Tối thiểu; sprite = the chosen option (user 2026-11-23: A, a little smaller -> scale 1.25; b/c kept for --hit-spark=x), drawn at world sprite_scale x scale. hitstop: the sim holds this many s when a hitstop_sources hit lands, at most once every hitstop_gap s.

events._doc: 6B events (design/events.md). ring = Vòng thử thách: opens `distance` px from the player at the region's event times (stages.json regions[].events), radius px, need = seconds inside to complete, limit = seconds before it fails, gold = coins dropped with the chest. meteor = Mưa thiên thạch: for duration s a mark every interval s within spread px of the player, lands warn s later (radius px), at most max_marks at once; hits the player for player_damage (armor applies) and monsters for monster_damage. gold_chest = Rương vàng: chance a dropped chest is gold; opening gives picks card picks in a row, gold coins, a sure item, and counts_as chests for Mảnh thẻ. source_names / source_icons: name (starting "Sự kiện:", so it is not mistaken for a skill) and icon of each event damage source in the end-of-run table. collect = Thu thập sao: count stars within spread px, pick each within pick px, all before limit s. hunt = Săn tinh anh: the region's elite (marked) appears distance px away, kill it before limit s. min_stage: region events (every kind) start at this stage, earlier stages are quiet (user 2026-11-21; --event still forces one). tornado / root_snare (replaced falling_trees 2026-11-23) / poison_tide: each region's own event, numbers in design/region-events-plan.md §4. enabled: false switches an event off (its region times are skipped; --event still forces it). (Mưa thiên thạch was removed 2026-11-21: every region has its own event.) Rewards: a chest + gold coins (user 2026-11-21: challenges easier and more varied; ring radius 110 / need 5 / limit 40).

crit._doc: Chí mạng (6C.2): chance and mul of direct hits (plus crit_chance / crit_mul effects); a crit on an elite or boss freezes the world hitstop s and shakes shake_crit px; the hero hurt shakes taken x shake_per_hurt px (2..7).

level_actions._doc: Level-up actions per run (6C.3, after Vampire Survivors Reroll / Banish / Skip): reroll = Đổi (new hand), banish = Loại (card out of the deck for the run, then a new hand), skip = Bỏ qua (no card, skip_gold gold).

balance._doc: Global tuning (user 2026-11-20: monsters too weak, hero too strong; no longer cooldowns): monster hp / damage multipliers, spawn_mul scales the plain waves' rates and bursts (fewer but stronger), player_damage_mul and player_area_mul scale the hero's damage and AoE size. Tuned with the demo runs (gamekit shot ... --demo; 'Run over' lines). xp_mul: xp per monster, so fewer monsters do not slow the levels (2026-11-20: spawn_mul 0.4 with stage rate growth 2%/stage up to x1.5 and max_enemies 200). xp_drop_chance: a plain monster drops its XP gem with this chance (elites and bosses always; user 2026-11-20: slower level-ups).

time_scale._doc: Monsters grow stronger at each minute mark of a run (user 2026-11-20): after k full every s, monsters spawned (not bosses) have hp x (1 + hp*k) and every monster hit deals damage x (1 + damage*k). User 2026-11-22: silently (no call), only from min_stage, at the region's own rates (stages.json regions[].time_scale {hp, damage}); hp / damage here are the fallback.

boss_outro._doc: When the boss of a boss stage dies (user 2026-11-21): every monster plays its death, the world runs at time_scale for time real seconds, the screen shakes, the call names the boss; then the win panel.

marks._doc: How elites and boss-buffed monsters are marked (roadmap F, user chose 2026-11-23): style outline = a 1-source-pixel glow round the sprite (Darktide-like rim), in the elite's affix colour (gold without one) or the boss aura colour for buffed monsters, pulsing at alpha; ring = the old circle under it. --mark-style= overrides (shots).
